properties.site-address: Second Hand Shop, King Street, Blyth
properties.notes: Commercial premises that could be redeveloped for residential uses, probably through conversion. Would represent an infill scheme within a town centre location. Approval for mixed-use scheme, including provision of 6 flats above ground floor retail/commercial units, lapsed without implementation (B/08/00054/FUL). A subsequent extension of time limit was refused (11/00064/VARYCO) with a previous proposal also refused and dismissed on appeal (APP/P2935/A/12/2189282).
